t: You're on King Street, a street in the City of London. It takes its name from Charles II, who was King of Scotland from 1649 until 1651, and King of England, Scotland and Ireland from the Restoration of the monarchy in 1660 until his death in 1685. So the name points back to the king who returned to the throne after the Restoration. Beyond that, I don't have much more to tell you about this particular street, so I'll leave you to enjoy the City around you.
